title: It's Happy Hour Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
h1: It's Happy Hour Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Located in Seaside with access to private beaches via the EAST RUSKIN access - Next door to the charming Seaside chapel (quiet neighbor) - 2 masters, one on the main level - You will have a total of 9 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Fully stocked kitchen complete with a standard drip coffee maker and Keurig - Walking distance to the Seaside shops and restaurants - Two adult sized beach cruiser bikes - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) 'It's Happy Hour' ... Every Hour! At least that's the motto at this beautiful 3-bedroom cottage (with 1 bedroom guest cottage rented together or separately) located on Forest Street in Seaside Proper next to the beautiful chapel and Ruskin Park. Just behind the town square and beside Seaside's chapel, It's Happy Hour is centrally located and close to all the action with just a short walk to the white, sandy beaches along 30A. 'It's Happy Hour' is flanked with screened-in porches and balconies giving you plenty of space for both outdoor and indoor living. Upon entering the cottage you'll enjoy open living spaces including a living room, flat screen TV, and wet bar. Also on the main floor is the open kitchen with island, separate dining room with seating for 6. You'll enjoy benches and desk space to hook up your computers or just sit back on the third floor and enjoy a good summer read. The Tower is also upstairs offering beautiful Seaside town views. This family friendly Seaside retreat offers something for the whole family. Beautiful open living spaces and upgraded bathrooms and bedrooms throughout. Make every hour...a happy hour when you stay at this delightful Seaside retreat! ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 9) Main Floor: Bedroom 1:Queen master retreat with flat screen and private, updated bathroom (shower only) Living room, kitchen and dining area Second Floor: Dual twin guestroom (sleeps 2) with hall bath Bedroom 3: King bed master retreat with flat screen TV and designer bathroom with shower and separate tub. Off (connected through) the master bedroom is an oversized bonus room with bunk bed with trundle (sleeps 3) and a new, large and comfortable sectional- perfect for Television watching and a perfect teen space! This room is private but is only accessed by walking through the master bedroom. This room also has a private balcony. IMPORTANT DETAILS ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. ** no pets allowed FREE WiFi Certificate # 069346 TDT # 7570 Amenities Location Type Beach Near The Ocean Safety Outdoor lighting Deadbolt lock on entryway Smoke detectors Carbon monoxide detector Fire extinguisher Health And Safety Enhanced cleaning practices Clean with disinfectant No-contact check-in and check-out High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF Kitchen Full Kitchen Refrigerator Coffee Maker Ice Maker Microwave Toaster Cookware Dishwasher Keurig Coffee Maker Living Air Conditioning Ceiling Fans Linens Washer & Dryer Ironing Board Outdoor Patio Balcony BBQ Grill Shared Pool Tennis Croquet Lawn Playground Entertainment CD Player DVD Player Stereo System WiFi 2 Bikes Included Smart TV Television Beach Town Beach Town -
